title: Planet Formation
blurb: Dust to worlds, and the snow line that decided why the inner planets are small. Includes the one step nobody has fully solved.

sources.claim: Disk temperature and MMSN surface density
Radial drift and the metre-size barrier

open: Classical isolation mass at 5 AU falls short of Jupiter core estimates. Pebble accretion is the leading fix and is noted in the panel.
